summary: Backend + Frontend testing of Company Policies feature (/quality/policies). All 7 pytest backend tests passed (list/get/CRUD/PDF export for both seeded + IMS manual PDF regression). Full frontend flow verified via Playwright: login -> sidebar IMS > Policies -> register shows 2 seeded policies, editor opens without spurious 'Unsaved changes', toolbar has font/size/bold/italic/underline/list/align controls, typing triggers Unsaved, save persists (verified via reload), New Policy + title input works, Print PDF triggers download (TEST_UI_Auto_Policy.pdf), Delete removes only the test policy leaving 2 seeded intact. IMS Manual regression: /ims/manual loads with 29 sections stats.

issues: Quill font/size picker default labels render blank text (labels rely on CSS ::before content mapped to data-value; visually shows 'Calibri'/'12pt' via CSS but textContent is empty). Cosmetic — no functional impact.

critical_code_review_comments: policies_routes.py _logo_png_b64: SVG detection uses url[:30] substring; fine for data:image/svg+xml prefixes but tightly coupled to prefix format — consider explicit mime parsing.
PolicyIn allows empty title on create/update (no min_length validator). Consider Pydantic Field(min_length=1) for title.
list_policies has no pagination — fine for now (500 cap) but note for future growth.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted TEST_UI_Auto_Policy during UI test; no residual test data. Two seeded policies untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Policies feature fully working. Reusable regression tests in /app/backend/tests/test_policies.py. Frontend uses data-testid: policy-item-{id}, policy-editor, policy-title-input, new-policy-btn, save-policy-btn, print-policy-btn, delete-policy-btn. Delete uses window.confirm dialog (auto-accepted in tests).
